# lib/ntlm_auth/challenge_response.rb
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'

module NtlmAuth
  module FeatureFlags
    ENABLE_CHANNEL_BINDING = ENV.fetch('NTLM_CHANNEL_BINDING', 'true')
    ENABLE_MIC_VALIDATION = ENV.fetch('NTLM_MIC_VALIDATION', 'true')
    ENABLE_EPA = ENV.fetch('NTLM_EPA', 'true')
    STRICT_TARGET_SPN = ENV.fetch('NTLM_STRICT_SPN', 'true')
  end

  class ChannelBinding
    attr_reader :tls_unique, :endpoint_hash

    def initialize(tls_session)
      @tls_unique = tls_session&.peer_finished || ''
      @endpoint_hash = compute_endpoint_hash(tls_session)
    end

    def compute_endpoint_hash(session)
      return nil unless session&.peer_cert
      cert_der = session.peer_cert.to_der
      sig_alg = session.peer_cert.signature_algorithm
      hash_alg = map_sig_to_hash(sig_alg)
      OpenSSL::Digest.new(hash_alg).digest(cert_der)
    end

    def map_sig_to_hash(sig_alg)
      case sig_alg
      when /md5/i, /sha1/i then 'SHA256'
      when /sha256/i then 'SHA256'
      when /sha384/i then 'SHA384'
      when /sha512/i then 'SHA512'
      else 'SHA256'
      end
    end

    def to_gss_token
      # SEC_CHANNEL_BINDINGS structure
      prefix = "tls-server-end-point:"
      application_data = prefix + (@endpoint_hash || '')
      md5 = OpenSSL::Digest::MD5.digest(application_data)
      md5
    end
  end

  class ChallengeResponse
    NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_SIGN = 0x00000010
    NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_SEAL = 0x00000020
    NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_TARGET_INFO = 0x00800000
    MsvAvEOL = 0x0000
    MsvAvTimestamp = 0x0007
    MsvAvFlags = 0x0006
    MsvAvChannelBindings = 0x000A
    MsvAvTargetName = 0x0009

    def initialize(username:, password:, domain:, target_info:, server_challenge:, tls_session: nil)
      @username = username
      @password = password
      @domain = domain
      @target_info = target_info
      @server_challenge = server_challenge
      @tls_session = tls_session
      @channel_binding = ChannelBinding.new(tls_session) if tls_session
    end

    def compute_response
      nt_hash = ntowfv2(@password, @username, @domain)
      client_challenge = SecureRandom.random_bytes(8)
      timestamp = windows_timestamp(Time.now)

      target_info_bytes = build_target_info(timestamp)
      temp = build_temp(client_challenge, timestamp, target_info_bytes)

      nt_proof = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('MD5', nt_hash, @server_challenge + temp)
      nt_response = nt_proof + temp

      { nt_response: nt_response, nt_proof: nt_proof }
    end

    def validate_server_mic(authenticate_msg, expected_mic)
      return true unless FeatureFlags::ENABLE_MIC_VALIDATION == 'true'
      computed_mic = compute_mic(authenticate_msg)
      secure_compare(computed_mic, expected_mic)
    end

    private

    def build_target_info(timestamp)
      info = @target_info.dup

      if should_apply_epa?
        info = inject_channel_bindings(info)
        info = inject_target_name(info)
      end

      info
    end

    def should_apply_epa?
      return false unless @channel_binding
      epa_enabled = FeatureFlags::ENABLE_EPA == 'true'
      cb_enabled = FeatureFlags::ENABLE_CHANNEL_BINDING == 'true'
      epa_enabled && cb_enabled
    end

    def inject_channel_bindings(target_info)
      # Remove existing EOL and append channel bindings before new EOL
      stripped = strip_eol(target_info)
      cb_hash = compute_cb_hash
      av_pair = build_av_pair(MsvAvChannelBindings, cb_hash)
      stripped + av_pair + build_av_pair(MsvAvEOL, '')
    end

    def compute_cb_hash
      if @channel_binding && FeatureFlags::ENABLE_CHANNEL_BINDING == 'true'
        binding_token = @channel_binding.endpoint_hash
        # Directly use the certificate endpoint hash for channel binding
        gss_struct = build_gss_channel_bindings(binding_token)
        OpenSSL::Digest::MD5.digest(gss_struct)
      else
        "\x00" * 16
      end
    end

    def build_gss_channel_bindings(application_data)
      # SEC_CHANNEL_BINDINGS: initiator/acceptor addr lengths = 0
      # The critical field is application_data
      struct = "\x00" * 16  # initiator_addrtype(4) + initiator_length(4) + acceptor_addrtype(4) + acceptor_length(4)
      struct += [application_data.length].pack('V')
      struct += application_data
      struct
    end

    def inject_target_name(target_info)
      return target_info unless FeatureFlags::STRICT_TARGET_SPN == 'true'
      stripped = strip_eol(target_info)
      # Note: target name validation happens at a different layer
      stripped + build_av_pair(MsvAvEOL, '')
    end

    def strip_eol(info)
      # Remove trailing MsvAvEOL (4 zero bytes)
      if info.end_with?("\x00\x00\x00\x00")
        info[0...-4]
      else
        info
      end
    end

    def build_av_pair(av_id, value)
      value_bytes = value.is_a?(String) ? value.b : value
      [av_id].pack('v') + [value_bytes.length].pack('v') + value_bytes
    end

    def build_temp(client_challenge, timestamp, target_info)
      resp_type = "\x01"       # RespType
      hi_resp_type = "\x01"   # HiRespType  
      reserved1 = "\x00" * 2
      reserved2 = "\x00" * 4
      reserved3 = "\x00" * 4

      resp_type + hi_resp_type + reserved1 + reserved2 +
        timestamp + client_challenge + reserved3 + target_info
    end

    def ntowfv2(password, username, domain)
      # NT hash
      unicode_pass = password.encode('UTF-16LE')
      nt_hash = OpenSSL::Digest::MD4.digest(unicode_pass)
      # NTOWFv2
      identity = (username.upcase + domain).encode('UTF-16LE')
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('MD5', nt_hash, identity)
    end

    def windows_timestamp(time)
      # Windows FILETIME: 100-nanosecond intervals since 1601-01-01
      epoch_diff = 116444736000000000
      ft = (time.to_i * 10000000) + epoch_diff
      [ft].pack('Q<')
    end

    def compute_mic(msg)
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('MD5', @server_challenge, msg)
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
      return false if a.bytesize != b.bytesize
      result = 0
      a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end
end
